name: Cognee AI Memory Platform with MCP
description: Cognee backend API, MCP in API/SSE mode, and managed Postgres + pgvector.

LLM_API_KEY.description: Your API key for an OpenAI-compatible chat/completions endpoint. Cognee also reuses it for embeddings unless EMBEDDING_API_KEY is set.

LLM_PROVIDER.description: Cognee LLM provider for an OpenAI-compatible custom API

LLM_ENDPOINT.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for chat/completions, such as a hosted API, LiteLLM proxy, or vLLM proxy

LLM_MODEL.description: Chat model name accepted by your OpenAI-compatible provider

LLM_INSTRUCTOR_MODE.description: Structured-output mode for the OpenAI-compatible LLM adapter

EMBEDDING_ENDPOINT.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for embeddings. Use the same endpoint as LLM_ENDPOINT when your provider supports embeddings there.

EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Embedding model name accepted by your OpenAI-compatible provider

EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.description: Embedding vector dimensions returned by EMBEDDING_MODEL. Update this to match your selected embedding model.

EMBEDDING_API_KEY.description: Optional separate API key for embeddings. Leave empty to reuse LLM_API_KEY.

GRAPH_DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string for graph persistence in single-user mode

GRAPH_DATABASE_HOST.description: Private Railway hostname for the graph Postgres connection

GRAPH_DATABASE_PORT.description: Port for graph persistence in Postgres

GRAPH_DATABASE_USERNAME.description: Username for the graph Postgres connection

GRAPH_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Password for the graph Postgres connection

DB_HOST.description: Private Railway hostname for the relational Postgres connection

DB_PORT.description: Port for the relational Postgres connection

DB_USERNAME.description: Username for the relational Postgres connection

DB_PASSWORD.description: Password for the relational Postgres connection

DB_NAME.description: Database name used by Cognee relational storage

VECTOR_DB_URL.description: Connection URL for pgvector-backed vector storage

VECTOR_DB_HOST.description: Private Railway hostname for the pgvector connection

VECTOR_DATASET_DATABASE_HANDLER.description: Dataset handler aligned with the pgvector backend

GRAPH_DATABASE_PROVIDER.description: Graph database provider for single-user deployments

ENABLE_BACKEND_ACCESS_CONTROL.description: Disable multi-user dataset isolation for a simpler single-user memory deployment

REQUIRE_AUTHENTICATION.description: Disable API auth for a single-user MCP-backed deployment

HOST.description: Bind address for the backend API service

ENVIRONMENT.description: Application environment label used by the backend service

TRANSPORT_MODE.description: Cognee MCP transport for remote clients. In production API mode, SSE exposes the server at /sse.

API_URL.description: Internal Cognee backend URL used by the MCP service in API mode

MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated public hosts allowed by MCP transport security for SSE access

API_TOKEN.description: Optional backend Bearer token used by the MCP service when cognee-api authentication is enabled.
